Flawa, flawaji ɗo ɓeɗo faunira saare on be majum, na saare bama ko ha babal kugal, ko bo haa babal ɓeɗo fauna dum. Debbo on o ɗo jogi flawa majum se ɓe hoosi ɗum hoto.

Shago,ba himbe anɗine,ɗo mahe on mussamman. Ngam goɗɗo jaba haya,kobo omara ɗum. Ngam goɗɗo pilira be majum. Ko bo o sorran ko omari haje fu ha nɗer ɗonɗon.
Leggal dibino ɗo awi ha nastorde saare ɗo tarni be waɗi tayils ha baranda man saare man waɗi penti danejum ɓe waɗi peshi ha les man ɗum do tiggi ha chi’e ngam faunuki nok kuje.

Cin andiraɗum be vesa, nda ɗum ɗo mari nonde ɓokko-ɓokko. Mashin nii ɓe ɗo watinaga nyebbam haa der a yaha haa a yiɗi fu be majum. Mashin nii ɗo mari taya ɗiɗi, himɓe ɗiɗi wawan vaugo do mashin man ɓe dilla fattuda.
Robaji be maɓɓode ɗo yawnindiri kanji nai manga be ko tokki be ko tokki be pamare nonde ɓokko ɓokko be maɓɓode daneje ɗo joɗi dow tais ɗo ɗi naftore ha siguki kare ha ci'e.
Ɓiɗɗo debbo o ɗo dari o fauni o wati riga mako juɗɗum nonde balejum, o ɗo waɗi ɗan kunne, o ɗo haɓɓi jawe ha junngo mako e nanta sarka ha ndande mako, o ɗo vo’ini gasa mako.
Paka nonde majum bodejum do wali ha leddi, paka ni ɓeɗo naftira ɓe majum ha yake to vuwi ada dotti yara ha nokkure rufata.
Milo ɓe madara ɓe ɗo naftira ɓeman  ha yaruki woɓɓe bo ɗo naftira ɓe madara ha yaruki nɗer gari, Nda ɓeɗo jerji ha nder kondo nder shago ɓe ɗo soradi.
Ndq riga juɗɗum be nyotiri, materiyal mai ɗo mari nonde ɓokko ɓokko danejum be nanta ɓalejum ɓe ɓili ɗum ha dow roba on ngam waɗugo talla kobo hollugo stail, roɓe ni ɓe andiri ɓe watugo irin kare ɗo.

korowal joɗugo ammaa korowal may na komay on ba, joɗata  haa mangal. Korowal ɗoni jey ɓe walaa kosɗe, jey ɓe kosɗe maɓɓe ɗo naawa, haa asibiti on, ɓe hokkata korowal may. To to ɓe hokki ma kosngal ma, ɗo naawa to a jooɗi haa totton, ɓe wara ɓe tuura ma, hedi ɓaawo.
Kanti sorugo hundeji nda biskitji ɓe ɗo sora biskit bo hunde on je nyamugo, musamman ma ɓikkon ɗo naftira be majum ɓe yidi kon ngam namugo ɗo vallita sosai.

Nyebbam zamanu andiraga jinja an tumeric, jinja an tumeric ni to goddo wuji dam habandu dam do vodina bandu bandu digga laral bandu digga walta goda bo to a wuji dam dam urna bandu ma dam do labbina laral bo sosai.

Sis onɗo,Sis maibo ɗum don mari set Majumi.Ɗum set of six on,Sis mai dipen on ɗime'on a Naftirta awaɗa,hundeji mai to Ndefuma ɗudɗum ko bana Supageti ma ayiɗi awaɗa Rinsin ta ɗuɗdum a naftira Manga mai, to Midiyom mai to Petel’on Sis mai a naftira ɗum Bana vigo a Sakira hunde kenan ko a itta Ndiyam a Accaɗum waɗa tiripin hanjum amfani Sis.

Ɓikkol pamaron ɗon fija bol kosɗe, ɓurna man ɓikkol man ɗon fiya bol man on to ɓe ummi brek ha  makaranta maɓɓe, ko bo to ɓe hokki ɓe siwtare ha ma makaranta man ɓe ɗon sare, ɓe ɗo heɓa bosesel fijugo bol man.
Moftorde himɓe siyaasa, himɓe siyaasa do doggina lamar da rauɓe ɓe do waati himarji woɓɓe fere do waati niqap maɓɓe yesoji maɓɓe worɓe man do hifni kifneeje woɓɓe fere do dari ha dow mahi Laara.
Unordu be ngafurgal, minɗo naftira be unordu ɗumɗo wata tattase ha nder  gafurgal minɗo una minɗona naftira beman hasare min una min naftira beman minɗo una citta.
Debbo ɗo ɓorni riga danejum, mori morɗi bega sa ɓalejum wati daroɗɗegite gite, o turni hore mako wati jambaki wati yeri guda ɗiɗi.
Ɗo serelak on bei kujeji fere, to serelak mai kuje on ɓeɗo hokka ɓingel keccel je yotti lebbi jego gam ɓingel  lebbi jego wala wawa  nyama nyiri sosai ngam o wala yi’e.

Himɓe ɗo jogi bol ɓeɗo wari nae mauɓe woroɓe ɓe tatto beɗo tokkidiri, ɗiɗo ɗo wati riga iri gotel be salla ɓalejum, mo tokkataɓee ɓawo ɗo mari kanjum bo ɗo wati kare hako hako, nda himɓe ji ɗo haɓawo maɓɓe goto ɗo tamdi bol.

Ɓiɗdo debbo odon fauni be kare lamu dondono o dum mattini jambaki ha hundugo mako odo wadi yeri odo wadi gazal ha hore mako ha geran mako odo habbi adiko odo wadi oldiji dodoni bo holla dum tari ha dondono.
Defteeji, ɓe ɗo jeeri defteeji on gudaa tati, kanjum ɗo ɓe ɗo sorra ɗum on haa babal ɓe sorrata defteji, defteeji man boo ɗo valla on haa anndunngo himɓe ko ɓe annda, ɓe ɗo janngira ɗum.
Tingeje be do wadi ha roba nondi danejum. Tingereni be do naftira be majum ha yake wa dugu hako. Robe do naftira ha kilanta mabb,do voina hako do mari nafu masin.
&o kankana ɗon joɗi.
"Hore leso" kafinta’en on fiyatago be katako ɓe ɗo naftira bo be dollof ha hore leso man heba voɗa woldurop bo totton ɓe sigata lemse dorowaji bo ɓe ɗo siga defte ha ton be waya.
Dou silin paalo labule kofi be ash, esi ɓe nana peuɗum dammugal kofi ɗo maɓɓi hiite ɗo haski penti danejum ha dou mahol.
Pukaraɓe be ɗo joɗi ha ɗer aji be ɗo janga. Hobbe fere ɗo larta ɗereji mabbe. Hobbe fere bo ɗo jogi aipaɗ waya ɗo lara.
Leggal fulawa ɗo dari den gene ɗo wagi hales leggal fulawa man ɓe mahi bo sera man ɓe tarni be rufi leddi on hidden ɓe asbini fulawa man ena gene wani hales man fubo ngam faunuki sare.
Kusel jei gortugal wulinga, sa'inga, ɓe ɗo nyama bannin, ɓe ɗo hauta be njaram, ɓe ɗo yara be tea, ɓe nyama ngam velo, be nyama ngam nango beldum.
Nda ɓiɗɗo debo tinna lengi juuɗe mako, nda leso, leso zamanu ɓe ɗo wala haa dow man, ɗo faunira cuɗi be majum.
Sare: Nda dammugal nastugo sare wi’etede gidan-sama. Dammugal famaral nda windo ha dou magal, nda fulawaji maunde nde ɗo haskinde. Sare maini penti danejum be ash kolo ɓe wanni'nde.
Nyebbam wujugo ɗo jeri ɗo mari nonde pink, danejum, be ɓokko ɓokko. Ɓeɗo naftira ha wujugo ɓandu, ɗo vo'ina ɓandu, ɗo vo'ina gasa ɓandu, ɗo ɗiggina ɓandu ɗelka.
Ɓibɓe ledɗe,ɓibbe ledɗe ɗo ɗo nder kondo,nda Dukkuje nda ayaba nda goiva nda kwakwa ko nandi e majum.Himɓe ɗo nyama ɓiɓɓe ledɗe ngam nanugo belɗum mabo vo’inike ɓandu be beddugol njamu ha ɓandu.

Ɗoo bo motaji on ɓedo do ƴonaɗi homa bos, don ha tasha je nasugo wada jahale be majuum, dilla jaha jaha be majuum, kokuma hukumaji pamaroɓ wada jahale be majuum ɓedo moftata kare meɗo moftata tele be majuum, be ko nandi be mai.
Kankana, lemu, ayaba, dukkuje, nda abarba ha sera, ɗo fu ɓikkon leɗɗe un ɗum en nyamata ha sare. Yake go en ɗo hautadi fu en waɗira njaretedam fere-fere ɓe majum.

Kuje paune je zamanu andra ɗum be halagare. Ɗum don waɗe ha juɗe. Roɓe e nanta worɓe ɗon naftira be majum. Ɗum ɗon waɗe ha dau koli meɗen. Ɗum kuje on jei vurtinta paune. Ɗum ɗon waɗe bo ngam paune on.
Nyiri marori carbech, cusel, hako stiw grenbains ha nder plat  danejum ndiyam ha nder gora dainin teb nonde danejum.
Da palo manga be fauni palu mai benanta pop  den be wadi dezign b pop mai bo ha bandu mahol dum hollata alama babal cigogo tv be do penti babal majum danejum.
Unordu benanta undungal. Ɓeɗo naftiro ɗum ha kichin gam ɓe unoro daddawa be albasa. Ɗon buwurɗi bo ha ɓawo man.

Laɓugo, laɓugo  voɗi masin ɓingel gorko mai laɓii voɗi gaasamai ɗo walti, ndabo ɓe didi ɓe didi lahiji guda nai, hedi sara noppi mako, nda noppi mako manga bo nda gefe bo ɗon gite mako vurti seɗɗa be kinal mako.

Himɓe ɗo les mayo, ɓeɗo ada kare nastina nder kolekole ɓe eran, debbo ɗo ɓamti juɗe mum, oɗo ɗo ɓorni limse danejum be ɓalejum, ɓingel gorko petel ɗo wati kare orench debbo do wakki boro mum ɗo wati siket, o ɓamta kare.
Jawe juuɗe, roɓe ɗon naftira be mai ha pawne, ɓe ɗo loowa jawe mai ha juuɗe, kolo jawe maajum goldin, jawe mai gudaa tati on, ɓe ɗo sigi ɗum dow kaapet, kolo kaapet maajum girin.
kofi jungo do joki kofi daroba herilesma kofi man penti danejo do naftira kofi ha yarugo ndiyan ko yarugo shayi kogari maudo deji ngel fudo naftira be kofi man nda dum do fauri vodi
Godɗo ha tasha wato nokore hosugo ummatore yara ɓe nokuji goɗe fere-fere je be mari haje, bodɗum masin ummatore to dilla tokka hedi tasha maju gam ɗo mari himbi ɗinare.
Oldi daande feere nonne feere, ɗum ɗon silvaa kolo, nden bo ɗona ɗo taari beenanta huunde feere bana jawe. Fahin ha hoore oldi ndin ɗo mari hat bee hooto ɓiɗɗo debbo e gorko ha ton.
Laawol mangol koltaa, umaatoore ɗo tokka saala e nanta ba’antenga ha sera man. Ɗon shaagooji nda ɓikon ɗo rondi talla, keke-napep haa nii ɗo wara.

Tattase  on onyiya'ata ɗo, amma ɓendai. Ɓeɗo 'yeuna ɗum grin pepe. Woɓɓe feri ɗo naftira be mai ɓe haura salat maɓɓe. Woɓɓe fere bo ɗo naftira be mai ɓe he’a ha nder nyamdu maɓɓe, nonman banni. Woɓɓe fere bo ɗo nyama ma bannin keccum mai.
Angalaje, angalaje ɓeɗo  naftira be majum on ko defugo hakko, ko defugo nyamdu, bo ɓeɗo naftira be majum ha dollugo lekkiji gargajiya ko shafi damba, be kujeji fere fere.
Deftere janguki tarihi fulɓe, ɗum wasiri sokkotawa vindi, ngam janga anda tarihi fulɓe.

hoto nga hollata tsari nyiɓalo dum be wi'ata akitekchoral dezign e dengal turankore ,to goddo mari haje nyiɓan maran haje sampul akitek gam bangida mo didadi iri nyibalo ko estet ko fattude dumbe yidi be wada.
Fandu moɗetekon, ɗur ɗo naftira be mako on ha moɗugo, den bo nyauda nyawu ha ɓandu inno adama, ɗo wallita masin ngam usango goɗɗo na walla.
Lebrari pellel on be siriyata defter ngam himɓe wara hosa njanga heɓa andal woɓɓe don naftira pellel mai ngam hebugo cede.
Tattase keccum ɗum ɓe andiri be green pepe, ɓe ɗo naftira be majum ha defugo takanas ma jolof. To a wadi jolof be green pepe a yiyai hokki dum pauni fere ni boɗɗum.
Mangoro da ɗe, ɗe ɗuɗɗe, ɗe ɗo ju gi ɗum ɓiɓɓe leɗɗe on amma ɗe ɓendidai sosai. To ɗe ɓendi ɗeɗo ɓura vojugo nden himbe ɗo nyama ɗe.
Fande ɓeɗo hutindira be fande ha dollugo ndiyam gulɗam, ɓeɗo  hutindira be fande ha harnugo gari, ɓeɗo  hutindira be fande ha lawugo nyamdu nyama.

Hanbak(Handbag) : A tawan rewɓe on ɓuri naftarago be hanbak ɗo ngam ɓe ngaɗa kukoi maɓɓe ha nder. To ɓe ngadan cede, telefon, jambaki, pinariji e'ko nandi be non kadi. Ɗo ngaɗa-ngaɗa ni kukoi ha nder.
Ba''anteeji jey ɗum anndiraa maasinji taaya ɗiɗi, Ammaa ɗo hawtinaamaa bee nokkoyel bana keeke-napep ɗum hoo’ata kare ɗo suuri, maa bo hoo’a ummatoore nder keekena-pep man.

Firij ɗo mabbiti. Firija ha ɗow. Ha lesbo ɗum firij man feunata ɗow man do wada kankara,les bo ɗo feuna. Pallel wore ha ɗer firij man. Firij ɗo mari ɗammuɗe ɗiɗi. Firij ɗo feuna hunɗe ɗo mari saman. Do vo’ina hunɗe haɗa vonnugo ko lammugo.
Ndaa nget milik be penti saare milik be hundeji lantarki be babwaya ha ɓandu saare mai ndaa leeda haa leddi be ngeene haa may haa sera lambtu.
Oldi, e maa yeri, ɗum pawne roɓe, oldi ɗum ɗo waate ha daande, nden bo yeri ɗum ɗo waate ha noppi, ɓurna fu ni, roɓe on fawnirta be mai, nden bo ɗum ɗo naftire ha dey-dey al'aadaaji fere-fere.
Himɓe ɗiɗi ɗo dari goto ɗo waati gare ɗo waati hofnere marun molticolo goto  bo ɗo waati jompa be humnere kala lait bulu wati waya nder jiba.

Babal sorugo bairo, maka, be stapla, ɗo jugi ha leddi ha nder chago ha nder kwali danejum, be boɗejum, ha dou majum stapla ɗo joɗi ɗo mari noude ɓalejum, ɓe ɗo naftira be majum ha ttai waɗugo stapin defte, maka ɓe ɗo naftira ha bindi.

Sare, nyibande timmina pentira penti hako ha kojum be danejum mahol mare faunirama be flawaji fere-fereji de wodi dammugal mangal gal jamdi ngal mota nastirta. bangoru mahol mai wodi poki himbe dido lodari der sare ma.

Debbo ɗo wati oldiji ha hore mako. Oldiji boɗejum o ɗo mori haɓɓi gasa mako man be oldi vicco gasa gotel foti vurti be oldi ha dow gasa majum dande mako bo pat oldi o ɗo dari bo titi ni hokkiti fiska mako gefe o ɓeddi bo gasa gera ha gite mako ɗo.
Supa-maaket, shaago soorata maakilin, ɗum ɗon naftire ha woggugo nyi'e ngam nyi’e laaɓa.
Ha dou tebur katao, wodi nyebbe kala tati, boɗejum, be leddi-leddi, be danejum, ha ɓawo mai wodi angalaje, albasa, be tumatur, be brokly be bafe pasley.
Goɗɗo on, ɗum alama ni holli injiniya on ɗo wo'tina njamdiji rotiji hore mako, o ɗo jogi spaina, o ɗo waɗi toggowol injiniya, o ɗo tijji woitina jamdi, ha dou.
Ɓiɗɗo debbo ɗo chanci gasa mako oɗo wati simi o ɓornai riga oɗo suddi yeso mako be emoji oɗo tiggi jungo mako ha dow jamɗe fere.
Lekkiji kolba 5o i do jeri bedo yara lekki gam nyaundingu gam nyambitina nyau bedo soraki gam sana’a do nyaunda ko chafi pewol.
Koromje joɗugo, ɗo mari lawni tati ɗeɗo joɗi, ɗo mari ndiyam danejum, ɗo mari ndiyam leddi-leddi, do mari ndiyam pura-pura ɗo joɗi. Ɓe ɗo joɗira koromje ɓe ɗo naftira ɗe ha bwatugo haa dessare.

Leddeji gargajiya ha der roobaji, ɗo naftira ngam fadduki nyau. Ɗo sofne, ɗo defa, ɗo yiwire, do waɗa hokka goɗɗo heɓa nyama ko yara heɓa tefa njamu mako. Ɗo naftira ha ɓandu, ha ɗo naftira bo goɗɗo yara heɓa njamu mako.
Restoran , himɓe ɗo nyaama nyamdu haa ɗoɗɗon, koromje ɗon jeeri, ɓe ɗo fawni babal man.
Ɓiingel ɗo dari  odo jogi gazal  oɗo wadi ɗum ha ɗow kine mako oɗo wati nyeɓɓam ha hunɗu ko mako roɓe ɗo fina gazal ha gite maɓɓe ngam faune ɓe ɗo wata nyeɓɓam hunɗu ko fuman ngam faune.
Frisa ɗo naftira ha waɗugo ndiyam pew ɗam be lemu ji jaram kolba ɗo feuna ngam hoitina yaruki, ha gefe dou  majum bo ɗon kekeji baugo be waɗi je waɗuki ecercise
Jawe juuɗe. Jawe ɓe ɗo naftirta bee maajum on haa pawne rewɓe jey ɓe kaɓɓata haa juuɗe. Ɓe ɗon waɗa ɗum bee njamdi koo ''plastic'', deedey ko haɓɓata deedey juuɗe mum.
Dafte ɗo naftira gam heɓuki andal ɓosiɗum ha caka ummatore, do naftira ha makaranta benanta tsare ngam jangunki ɓukkwai,  ɗo naftira ha ko lara ni jangirde be heɓuki andal ko shafi dina.
Pampo lotugo juɗe ɓe ɗowaɗa irin pampo ɗo on musamman gam lotugo juɗe, musamman ha asbiti ko ha makaranta nden ndenta bo ɓe ɗo naftira ɗum ha asibiti gam hulugo nyauji.
Lekki moɗe teki pirmol on to goɗdo nyauɗo bojabido dama mo ko hore ko nawor redu ko kosɗe sei moda lekki man do wada dama
Nyebbam ɗum ɓe naftirta ha hunduko ngam haɗa hunduko yorugo ɓurna funi roɓe on naftirta be irin nyebbam ɗo takanasma wakkati jangol to aɗo wata irin nyebbam ɗo wakkati jangol hunduko ma yorata.

Gora on ndaɗum juɗɗum danejum. Sabulu yuwugo on hatotton, kanjum ndiyam diyam on min ɗo ƴonar ɗum showajel je goɗɗo ɗon yiwura be man, ɗo gera ɓaŋdu, waltina ɓaŋdu, waɗa smoth vo’ina larar goddo sosai.

 Ko Ɓe Sorrata Ɓanta Ɗefte, Ɓindirgol, Reza, Ɓoroji, Paɗe, Yaɗi.

Nokkure nyamuki e yaruki, a wawan a yaha a soda nyamdu ha nokkure man a joɗa a nyama to a timmini a yoɓaɓe cede maɓɓe,a nanga lawol ma a wurta nden bo a wawan a soda a hora sare a ya a joda a nyama na hautade hakkilo ma ɗo firi ba ko ɗo ummi ba,hakkilo ɗo wali a nyama be hakkilo.

Kuula nƴiiri be haako ɗo jooɗi ha leddi, nda durowa katako kombi mai, ɓe ɗo waata nƴiiri be haako ha kuula ni ngam ta nƴaamdu feewa, nden nden ɓe ɗo waata nƴiiri be haako on to a ummi a essa a nƴaama.
Ɗoo bo moggal himɓe on, ɓe ummi julurde nakusa ,ɓe ummi sallikeere yannde julde komoy ɗo fawni, ndaa o ɗo hippi salaya, haa dow hoore maako ɓe ɗo dilla.

Inji chekugo leɗɗe, ɓeɗo naftoro be inji ɗo kadi gam ta’ugo leggal takanasma iri leɗɗe mauɗe ɗo,  a tawan ɓe ɗo ta’ira ɗe, ndenbo reta irin katakoji be sorata ɗo nga fi wurgo ce'ipat be irin inji ɗo ɓe naftorto ngam ta’ugo ndenbo inji mai bo huwata  sebe nyebbam.

Beebi irin jey ɓe ɓornata kare to ɓe sorran ɗo, kannjum ɓe won ɓe ɓorni ɗum kare ɓaleejum, nda karemay bana jey indiya on, be sarla bo ɓaleejum, be paɗe ɓaleejum, kare may bo ɗo mari pawne botton-botton be boggol ni bana oldi daande.

Kuulaaji tati ɗo jeeri, bee peetel mai haa leddi, ɓe ɗo naftira bee may, ngam ɓe wa'ata nyiiri koo haako koo huunde feere ngam taa feewa, ɓe waaway ɓe yaara fattude, ko ɓe naftira haa saare.
Citta tattase e' na tingere ha nder tasa. Bedo naftira de ha wadugo hako. Ngam himbe nyama hara.
Ɗo ɗum ɗosta, roɓe ɗo naftara ɗum ngam waɗugo pauda ha yeso maɓɓe, ngam ɓe mo’yina yeso mai, be waltinago, be itta putte ngam bo woɗa.

Bredi, be ɗo nyama gam velo, ɓe ɗo nyama gam nanugo
belɗum, ɓe ɗo hauta be takai, ɓe ɗo nyama bei ti ɓeɗo nyama be jus ɓeɗo nyama be ndiyam.
Tassaje ɗum naftirte ha kicin haa saare. Tasaaje nda ɗe lumbidiri robaaji ɗei jei didi, gotel man ni pamaron be manga ɗum ɗo naftira tasaaje ɗo ni ha wadugo nyamdu ngam himbe nyama.

Lawol koltaya. Nɗa mota oɗilla ha ɗow. Nɗa sera majum ɗon leɗɗe. Ha seran fahin ɗon sa'inbot ɗo ɗari ha totton. Lawol koltaya ɗo motaji ɗo tokka ɗow totton. Beɗo tokka. Keke napep ɗo tokka be mashin fu.
Kitchen ware je kitchen ɓe ɗo wata plat ji ha nder, goɗɗo ɗo siga tasaje mun ha nder, ɗo siga kofiji ha nder  be chokali ji, to sigi ni na seto tefi ha siga ba heɓi babal sigugo kuma joɗa safe.
Gafrugal dammuɗum ɗo bari ha ɓandu mahol suudu, nda dammugal suudu mai ɗo maɓɓiti, dammugal jamdi ha leddi ɗo tanki, ɓe ɗo naftira gafrugal una.

Ged: Kala sare mari mota pat ɓeɗo waɗa ged. Ged ɗo mari amfani sosai ɓeɗon maɓɓitira ɗo nafa ngam hala wuiɓe, hala ɓukkonji wala hakkilo hakkilo ɗo pat ged. Ɗo nafa a ata ngam to a kubli nge maini wala nastowo. Miɗo lara mota ha sera mai, sare mai bo ɓeɗo penti ba girin.
Ɗo ɗum yeri guda ɗiɗi haa nder juɗe goɗɗo. Rowɓe ɗo naftora ɗum wata haa noppi ngam ɓe fawnoro.
Derke’en fijoɓe bol ɓeɗo dilla ha sera lawol, be kolte maɓɓe ɗe fijerde majum, boɗɗum masin fijugo fijerde man ngam ɗeɗo sankita i'yam, ɗedo bo wallita ha hokkugo derke’en chede.

Ngilngu ɗo jooɗi haa nder taasawo silva. Ndabbawa on peppeton ɗo wona haa ladde bee haa nder gure, ɗo tokka dow baafe ɗo nyaama baafe, feere ɗo wula ɓanndu goɗɗo to meemi goɗɗo. Ɗo mara kosɗe peppetel ɗudɗum.
Saare en ɗo nyiɓa on ngam en jooɗa, en waɗa rayuwa  nder maare, denden tabo saare ɗo kanjum On rufin asirin ɗan adam musamman haa ja'umu teegal.
Ɓiɓɓe bol kosɗe ndaa ɓe, woɓɓe feere ɗo turu, feere bo ɗo dari, mi ɗo waati kare nonde gootel, be paɗeeji. Bol ni fijidde on, jey dereke’en yiɗi fijigo, ɗo mari bote bo masin.
Róubé ha ngesa dá goddo bó ha sera debbo man do jogi kondo, kondo dó bé dó itta biɓbé ledde wata ha nder mán.Dá ladde manga ledde fere fere há ndér dá débbó gotó dobó dó jodí.
Nder sudu, palo ɓe ɗo fauni ndu. Ɓeɗo waɗi koromje alfarma trisita e'nanta piloji mum. Ha chaka man bo ɗo mari tebul e'nanta glas ha dau majum je ɓe sigata hunde ha dau ton.

Koɗol, koɗol ɓuri andirego be sarƙa. Ɗum ɗo naftira haa paune kare rewɓe ɗum bo ɓe waɗata haa ndaande maɓɓe, ngam laatina ɓe faune, wo’ina ɓe, vo’ina ɓalli maɓɓe, nden yaada be nanta koltal ngal ɓe waati.

Goddo do ƴabbita lawon ,o do borni riga mako be sallajins ,o do jogi ledda balejum ha jude mako ,odo watippade mako worbe ni don borna irum karedo ngam faunugo holtado bobe wari on gam ƴabbutuggo daci’eji ha sera man.
Lekki asbiti je ɓe hokkata ha asbiti to goɗɗo nyauɗo moɗa ɗon je wujugo be je tufugo batal.
Deftare, fukaraɓe ɗo naftira, mallu'en ɗo naftira, waɗoɓe bincike ɗo naftira. Ɓe resa ndu ha sudu jangirde vi'etende laibrari. Mo ummi fu ya hosa naftira, wartira.
Deftere winda nde profeso Isa Ali Ibrahim Fantami. Nde o indi skils rada dan just de digiri. Ma'ana wawu go kugal juɗe na wai marugo ɗereji digiri tan ba.
Debbo ɗo mori hore mum ɗo voɗi, oɗo mori morɗi mako manga-manga ɓe mori mo ɓe vurtini pecci, morɗi mako ɗo voɗi mo laari fu andi o'mori morɗi boɗɗi.
Taro siyasa be himɓɓe ɗuɗɗum, ɓe ɗo ɓorni kare kala. kala
Fijobe bol ɓe ɗo dari ha filin bol, ɓawo to ɗo bo totton laroɓe bol mai joɗata, ɓe ɗo wati jersey boɗejum, blu, yelo, ɓe ɗo paɗi buts be bol ma bo ɗo joɗi ha leddi.

Korom je ɗo ve’iti be labule ɗo fauni haa palo. No ɓe faunirta irin labule ɗo nii ɓe ɗo hokka tela yadi nyouta, waɗa bicci bicci haa dow majum, ɓawo to ɓe penti palo ɓe timmini nden ɓe wara ɓe haɓɓa ɗum ngam paune.

Puramari school certificate. Ɗo to goɗɗo mari ngol ni ɗum holli dow kanko o timmini jangirde arandere wato priimari school. Nden bo ɗo ɗum ɗereji tabbitingo abdul waris sani umar timmini jangirde nde primari sukul, mako ha nder jiha kano, to kanjum on nafu dereji mai banai.

Paɗon ɗon fere-fere ha nder basket ɓe ɗo mari dizin daban-daban, wodi danejum, wodi ɓalejum, wodi bulu, wodi boɗejun, nden fere do mari dizin majun, goɗɗo watan cosɗe on tan, fere ɓo ɗo mari kine bana silipas, fere bo ɗo mari paune be guci, den fere do vindi zara shu ha bandu majum, roɓe ɗo naftia be paɗe hala paune.
Biddo debbo do fauni be limse mako danejum balejum odo dari ha kombi dammugal do wakki boro mako ha mako.
Dammugal manga ɓeɗo lowa ngam mota wara sala ko to ɓe  heɓi kare je be faltaka ko ha dammugal petel ɓeɗo salirta ha dammugal.
Kare caago zamanu anndiraaɗum supamaket, urdi guda joyi ɗo resi haa dow kanta, guda nayi ɗo nanndi, gootel ɗon feere, kanjum ɓaleejum.
Tutawal nonde manni bulu be boɗejum ɓe bokko bokko ɓe yelo, ɓe ɗo naftira on ha hollugo alama ɗo wuro on ɗo, nden inde wuro man ɓe tindinore wuro man.
Pewnirɗum, na, ura fewnugo sudu andira ac. Ɗum ɗon naftire ɓawo to ɗum hawta ma be njayri lantarki. Ɗum waɗe ngam fewnugo nokkuyel ko larani sudu, mabo nukkuyel ummatore joɗata.
jungo ɓiɗɗo debbo ɗo wadi lalleni voɗugo ɗo jogi waya nda zobe mako nda hunde jungo da agogo pat ha jungo gotel lalleni ni ɓiɗɗo debbo ha faune zobe ma be jawe be agogo fu ɗo ɓingel debbo to fauni

Nɗa ɓukkon do jodi ha sudu hosugo jangirde,  ɓe ɗo wati faksmak hunde mabbititta mab kine oɗo jogi kompyuta tab kobe jangata beimai fecemaks ni ɓe don wata ɗum ɗo kara nyau ɗuɗum tap bo ɓe ɗo naftira bei mai a jangan darasi ɓe jangintama mabbita a lara to wodi ko afamai a lara.
Pellel Nyamugo: Ɓeɗo sora nyamdu, ɓeɗo sora sha'i, ɓeɗo sora ndiyam. To ɓe sodi, ɓe joɗa ha dou tebulji be koromje ngam ɓe nyama, ɓe yara.

Filoji, ɓeɗo naftira be filoji ngam faunugo sudu, a fauniran palo ma, a watan ha ɗo koromji ma, a faunira palo ma be filoji majum a watan ha dou leso ma ɓo a faunira sudu ma, a faunira leso ma be mai.

Nyootirɗum kolte je zamanu, andiraaɗum be keeke. Ɗum ɗon naftire haa wakkati nyootuki kolte, ɗum ɗon valla soosai haa wakkati hoitinki kuuɗe nyooli, ɗum ɗon ta’a yaadiiji be ko nandi e maajum ha min wara min nyota dow maajum, ɗum ɗo yaaɓe be kosɗe, goɗɗi bo ɗon naftira be hiite lamtarki.

Defteji ɗuɗɗum ɗo jooɗi dow tebur. Luttuɗum bo ɓe ɗo seeki-seeki sera man, be pepahoi man ɗon rufi haa dow leddi. Ɗum shago on bo, jee ɓe sorrata defte. Haa ɓandu shago man bo, nda too himɓe, hotoji himbe fijoobe bol. Nda limseeji fu ɗo bili ni haa nder shago man. Kapet fuu ɗo ve’iti haa les man.
Cuca. Cutawal leddi fere on mari nolle kala tati, ɓokko ɓokko be boɗejum danejum hasira
Goɗɗo don fiya bolwa ha pele fejugo bol man, o ɗon duhi sarla jutka be toggowol danewol, o ɗon faddi paɗe danejuum.
Royal tuu siita jey jooɗugo himɓe ɗiɗi, ɗon pilo tati haa dow maajum, foo kona ha sera-sera be raawun haa caka ɓe ɗo naftira bee maajum ɗo ngam jooɗugo ɓe fawnugo pellel.
Nyiiri be Njaram: Njaram majum iri je jamanu njaram man bo fere-fere. Ɗon boɗejum, ɗon ɓalejum, ɗon ndiyam, ɗon bo savin-op, nden bo ɗon nyiiri.

Jarendi do wagi haba bal do en do naftira be jaredi ni ha hundeji fere fere be do rufa jaredi ha chaka sare ngam voitungo sare mai voda, be do jiba siminti be jaredin ha wadugo mahol be konandi be mai.
Kareji paune roɓe ɗum hebete ha nokuwel sorugo kareji paune, hauti be nanta oldi wato sarqaji, be nanta ɓikkon noppi yeri ɗum andira ɗan kunne, be jawe je ɗum naftorto ha waɗugo ha juɗe.
Fulawaaji ɗo aawi haa sera mahol nden boo ɗo tarni bee njamɗe nden woodi leɗɗe fulaawa ɗum ɓamtiri ɗo tiggi haa les mahol man hedi yaasi. Fulawaaji ɗin ɗi ɗo wo’ina saare den boo ɗum pawne.
Nauraji ɓe spainaji fistugo to ɗon ko wonni hana uraji man, spainaji man ɗon kashi tati playa ɓe spaina fistugo ,ɓe ɗo haɓɓira notin ɓe ɗo fistira notin ɓe man.
Ice crim, ice crim ɓe ɗo sora ngam himɓɓe ɗo wara soda, ɗon yara ngam nanugo ɓeldum,hokka ɓukkoi yara gyara, sukaɓɓe ɗo sona ɓuduje maɓɓe yara , zaman takewa.

Sicurul direva ɓe ɗo sigi ha liddi, domari nonde bodejum, haa juungo man. Ɓe ɗo naftira be majum ngam fistugo e nanta haɓɓugo soket. Makaniki en gero ɓe yiite e nanta makaniki en tivi be radio ɗo naftira be man.
Gaasa jei attashmen morɗi ha dou hore goigoi, ɓe ɗo resi ha do hunde fere ɓaleejum. Gaasa ɗon naftre ngam paune rowɓe, ɗo moori be nanta bit.

Paɗeji rooɓe feere-feere  roɓe ɗon naftira be irin paɗeji ɗo on ngam paune maɓɓe, ɓe ɗon paɗa irin paɗe ɗo to ɓe vurtan yahugo pattule, ɓe don hauta irin paɗe do ko be riga juɗɗum ko be gudel be riga.

Ɓinngel debbo ha babal morugo be lotugo hore, ɓe ɗo vi'a ɗum salun, o yehi o mori gaasa mako  be beddini mo be gaasa atashimen juuti sosai, odo ɓorni riga mako pink, oɗo dari, nda goto ha ɓawo mako be riga ɓaleejuum dammuɗum walajungo be hunde lotugo hore be morugo.
Shagon ina irin shago mangaru. Je goɗɗo ya ha subta wonɗe on yiɗi be jungo mako do. Ɗa motaji bo guɗa ɗiɗi walani ko wala ha shago mai ha be kare fu.
Kawano sare ɗo mari mahol ha bandu magol ɗon leɗɗe fulawa mari pindi fere haɗo mai be hako keccum hasara man ɗon geɗo maɓɓi bandu mahol mai wadaka penti .

Filet be takaire mai. Filet ni ɓedo wata nƴamdu on, ɓe nƴama takaire mai bo ɓe ɗo wata hako on nƴama nƴiri. Himɓe feere ɗo wata ferfesu, himɓe feere ɗo wata furut, himɓe feere ɗo wata kosam ha sosa mai, takaire haako mai. filet mai bo himɓe feere ɗo wata ndiyam hokka goɗɗo. Himɓe feere bo ɗo wata furut maɓɓe ta'a, naftira be mai. Kala saare fuu a yahi a tawan filet ɓe ɗo naftira be mai sosai.
Booro wakkaao fukaraaɓe, ɗum ɗo naftira be maago on ha waatugo kujeji fere-fere takanas ma defte, compiuta, e ma goɗɗi.
Dago hunde on je be sanyata dum be barira be kuma be bali. Ɓeɗo wada dum on do ve’iti bannin ɓe ɗo naftira be majum hasare be verna hobbe bo kuma be joda ha do mai ha sakasare.
Saare, leggal ɗon dari haa yonde may, ɓe ɗon naftora ngam waalugo, woɓɓe ɗon nyiɓa ngam hokka haya.

Fanta der kan, ɓe do naftira ɗum ha buki, ɓe doo yara gam nanugo belɗum, ɓedo siga hasaare heɓata ɓe wari e hokaɓe ɓeo siga a ofisis heɓata ges wari ɓe hokkaɓe, kokuma ɓe wari ɓe hokkaɓe ha ofice ɓe do naftara be mai ni hajulurde ha reception kohatoi  toini ɓeɗe naftira be mai.
Fanka dou haɓɓa nga ha dou. Ɗum ɗo naftira be maanga on ha kunnu go'nga, nden hokka goɗɗo hendu ha nokkure nga woni majum her wakkere hite lantarki.
Sare dousare, be nanta maɓɓode nastugo sare majuum, dum ɗo nyiɓande on gam doggina kuɗeeji hande ejango, den bo nasta wala nder mare gam hisna goɗɗo waalugo yasi.
Gas kuuka ɗo joodi. Ɓe ɗo waɗi ovun haa dou maajum. Gas kuuka ni ɓe ɗo naftira be majum ngam defugo. Ɓe ɗo defa nyamdu haa dou maajum, haa les haa gefe bo bokiti njamdi ɗo jooɗi.
Yonɗe sare, get ɗamugal on mangal. Totto mota nasirta sare ko mashin. Ha get mai ɓo woɗi ɗammugal petel, je Tonto himɓe tokkata nasta sare man. Ɗon kawaɗo ha get mai nonɗe get mai balejum.
Ingel debbo, ɗo mori gasa mako ɓale ha, ɗo hauti be jeo ɓedditi je nandu bodejum, ɓe wujini ɗum yebbam je ɗiggitinta hore mai bo ɓeddina ɗum haske.
Salum je rowɓe babal rowɓe yahata joɗa ɓe lotinaɓe gasa laaɓa, ɓe ittina ɓe dotti gasa, ɓe ɗo wanna ɓe gasa kanti, woɓɓe bo ɓe loota tan be dilla.

Filai ova, lawol jamanu on je ɓe watata ɓeɗo tokkata ha dou, be ha les, be ha seraji mai fu. Ɓeɗo waɗa laabi mai ni ngam wo'ungo wuro. Nda ɗo ni ɓe waɗi da gadawol ha dou to ɓeɗo tokka ha les bo ɓe tok motaji ɗo tokka ɓeɗo fauni bo babal majum be girin, be  white, ɓe danejum.
Ɓikkoy guda tati ɗo jooɗi haa dammugal saare, ɓe ɗo fija gooto ɗo dari,ɓe ɗiɗi bo ɓe ɗo jooɗii haa dammugal saare may.
Kifneje nonde ɗiɗi fere fere, worɓe on ɓe andi be watugo kifneje, ɗo nder paune kocworɓe nafturta ha waɗugo paune be majum,  paune ifnere ɗo fottina worɓe masin kanjum waɗi ɓe yiɗi watugo.
Gemage ɓe ɗo wallini dou  jarida gemage bo ɗum sondu on du ɗo fiira ɓurna fu du ɗuɗai vurtugo be naage sai be jemma.

Mota manga ɗo dari, ɓawo mai ɗon maɓɓiti hebbini be kare. Himbe ɗo jippina buhuuji kare mai. Mota mai ɗo ada kare masin. Ko irin kare toi a watan ha nder, bana buhuuji marori, buhuuji nyebbe, ko a mari haje pat a watan ha ɓawo mota bo yarinte ha a yiɗi pat, no daayiri pat.
Feho  ɗum ɗo naftira be mago on ha wadugo mase de go be mabbode mago ɗo wallita masin hedi wadugo mase man der jauɗum den maseman ta katako.
Apul nii ɗuɗugo ɓe ɗo jeri wati haa nder kwali. Apul nii ɓikkon leɗɗe, ɓe ɗo naftira be maakon ngam yarugo waɗa jus nyakka bannin, ɗo mari nafu masin.
Debbo ɗo dari, o ɗo ɓorni limse, o ɗo fauni o ɗo suddi gele, nden o ɗo ɓamti jungo maako. O ɗo takki lalle ha jungo mai, lalle boɗeejum, nden o ɗo waɗi sharƙa bo ha dande maako.
Leggal keccal bu'angal mota vo’ongo labi jururɗe ɓe ɗo naftira ngam hokkutugo wakkati je.

Biɗdo ɗebbo oɗo mori gasa mako rufitika ha bawo. Oɗo waɗi bit ha karce morɗi man. Oɗo waɗi yeri ha noppi mako. Oɗo wati toggore balere marnɗe ɗiɗi boɗejum. Beɗo naftoro be majum be fauna be beɗɗa woɗugo.
Aji mai ɗo tanki be siminti, koromje mai brawun be njamdi ɓaleje. Ummatore ɗo joɗi dou majum. Ɓawo mai blackboard on be goɗɗo fere ɗo dari wadi riga yelo. Ɓeɗo jaɓa lectures, ɓeɗo janga.

Ɓingel oɗo joɗi be gasa mako mati nyibbam gasa mai koilin, yeso mai wadi jals o wailini oɗo wadi yerglas mako pink, noppi mako wala yeri woles moosa odo wati nibba mako jsted hore mako do tan be holli be galagal mako.
Fijooɓe waɗoɓe dambe, ɓe ɗo haɓa haa nder babal daaga maɓɓe may, ndaa ɓe ɗiɗo haa nder, ndaa luttuɓe bo, ɗo dari haa yaasi, ɓe ɗo laara haɓarde maɓɓe.
Naa'ura je min ɗonata ovun, ɗo joɗi ha sira majun dum maɓoode guda ɗiɗi, ɗo naftira ɓe hite lamtarki, ɓe ɗo naftira ha wulugo kusel ɗo naftira ha wadugo mitpai be kek.
Injiwa waɗugo aiskrim ɗum ɗo dari nda goɗɗo ɗo ha yeeso man ɗo dari den himɓe bo ha sera man, ɓe ɗo jooɗi ɗon ɓiɗɗo debbo ha totton.
Shever, bano’ inanta Manjagara, ɓedo naftira be majumni gam vuhugo dasa gene hasare ko nanta ladde ɓedo naftira be bano bo gam remugo.
Derke on nayo ɓeɗo fija bol jungo, goto ɗo taskiti dogga ɗo fiya bol may ha leddi, goto be riga boɗejum ɗo aatamo, goto yeso ɗo ɓamti jungo aatan mo goto ɓawo oɗoo wara be doggudu.
Hot pilat ɗum katane defugo nyamdu. Ɓe ɗon naftoro katane ɗo hayite lantarki a hosan hore soket man a wata ɗum handir soket lantarki nden a kunna a wa’ina payanga maɗa.
Laawol kolta. Nda ɓiɓbe makaranta ha dou laabi mai, nda ba’eteɗi ha dou laawol.

Lim limse je roɓe ɗo sili sili je choggu, nonde bulu be pink, nonde burown be girin, nonde boɗejum be yelo, nonde danejum be yelo nonde burown, chokolette be yelo nonde popule be laite popule.
Moftorde himɓe, ɓe ɗo mofti ha palo, fere ɗo joɗi, fere ɗo dari, ɓe ɗo wati jompaji maɓɓe kala-kala, be kifneje, ɓe hosi hoto.
Leso kesum do jodi, be drowa peppetel, be wodrob, ɓe ɗo naftira be man ha sudu be sigaga ngam himbe wala do leeso.

Lekki ɗum ɗon wara haa nonde ji feere-feere, goɗɗi haa kwali ji, goɗɗi haa paali. Ɗum ɗon jaɓe haa huɓɓirle nƴaundingu  andiraɗum bee asibiti, maa bo kemis. Ɗum ɗo jaɓe ngam wara heɓa yara, heɓa njamu haa ɓalli meeɗen. Dedai wakkati min nani ɗon ko ɗo daama meeɗen haa ɓalli.

Be gafurgal. Ɓe ɗo naftira dum ha kicin, ɓe ɗo naftira dum bo ha unugo kujeji hako bana tattashe, daddawa, basko je, bokko, be ko shafi hakoji mai fu. Unordu mayni beɗo waɗa  ɗum be leggal on be seha ɓe waɗa unordu be gafurgal.
Kuje ladde kada bannaru ɓe ɗo nanga ɓe hirsan ɓe nyama, ɓe defan ɗum be hautina ɗum kayan haɗi.

Jungo debbo on ɗo lowi woro woro guda tati, woro woro arande ɗo ni kolo silva, jei chaka ɗo goldin jei qarshe mai silva, jungo maako bo bayo on, oɗo mari gaasa ha ɓandu sosai, jawe bo rooɓe ɗo lowa ngam paune on.
Ɗo ɗum kifneje ɓiɓɓe roɓɓe ɓe ɗon naftira gam mojuki hako e maɓɓe.
Ardiɗo lesdi owa’i piirawol oɗo daari oɓamtini jamaje maako juuɗe.Oɗo waati lumse ndiyaam zaregiina be botinji nayi ha juuɗemai,be hifineere ha hoore mako.
Himɓeji ɓe ɗo joɗi ha dow dagali jei sare larugo fijirde, wodi worɓe be roɓɓe ɓe ɗo ɓorni kare fijirde.
"Nyebbam hunduko" ɓeɗo naftira ɓe majum robe ngam faunugo ɓeɗo wuja ha hunduko maɓɓe hebata hunduko yora.
Yeri ɓe ɗo wada ɗum on ha noppi ɓe ɗo faunira be majum sarqa bo ɓe ɗo waɗa ɗum on ha nda nde Kanju fu ɓe ɗo waɗa on gam paune, burna pat roɓe on naftirta be majum.

Ɓikkon talla guda ɗiɗi ɓe ɗo rodi talla maɓɓe bana biriji puri mabo aya, ko koi gam be sorra, ɓe ɗo dari lara hunde on ha shago, handi saro’en amin ɓe acca accugo himɓe ɗon yaha torde gam tornde woɗai.
Dottijo do jodi jogi deftere al kur’ani janga, da leda mako bullu do jodi ha sera mako do jodi dow korowal morni limse danejum.

Hotowa ɓiɗɗo debbo e mo jooɗi haa dou korwal, mo ɓorni riga pink, be nanta duhi sarla. Sarla ka ka rammai, ka juutai, ka sali koppi ka yottai kolɓule. Nda mo jogi juuɗe mako hedi les, mo ferlindiri kosɗe. Woodi fandu ndiyam ha sera maako wakkere nano.
Himɓi fere fere ɗo dari ha babal moftorde. Goto ɗo dari, goto bo ɗo turi wadi daaroɗe, be ɗiɗi bo ɓeɗo turi wadi daaroɗe ɓe ɗo hauti ndira jungo hofni ndira.
Leso ɓeɗo naftira be leso hasare, ɓeɗo ve'ita ha sudu, drowaji be faunira gefe gefe, be dresin miromum, woldurob bo ɓeɗo resa limse on hander alim ta wada chollaje.
Ɓa:al nyamugo nyamɗu. Ɓe ɗo jeri ɓe koromje, ɓe tebur. Koromje mai ɓo je katako on. Nɗa ɓeɗuji ha totton, nɗa tivi ha sera mai, nɗa ɗammugal nastugo ɓaɓal mai.
Lekki ha shago islamic kemis, bedo sora lekki kala kala ha shago mai bedo sora je keni je nawugo balli bannin wala je wala don je yargo don je wujugo.

Babal fijugo bol rewɓe bee worɓe pat ɗon fija bol, nden denta boh to'a laari goddo oyehi o fiji bolni o fiji'on ngam o sankita iiƴam mako ko'o jartina ɓandu, nden ndenta boh atawan yimɓeji ɗuɗɗum yahi dari ɗo lara ngam ɓe seina bernɗe maɓɓe.
Tursuje, dum biɓbe ledde on dum min nyamata, ɓiɓbe ledde maini lammu dum top wakkati fere to goddo nyama ma sei to hauti benan ta kilbu ma bo shuga.

Mase. Jungo goɗɗo ɗoo jogi mase ficciti mase man, o ngati reta lutti reeta, o ɗoo jogi ɗum, ɓeɗoo nyama mase ngam harande ɓeɗoo nyama mase bo ngam ittugo suno, nda fere hales bana be haku boɗeejum do majom
Ɓiddo debbo oɗo jodi morɗi do ha hore mako ɓeɗo naftira be attachman ɓeɗo ɓedda jutugo gaso mai be vodugo maka be dezign mordi mai fu.

Karton lekki, ɗo mari nonde danejum, be windi balejum e nanta bodejum ha banduman, ɗo naftira be lekki to tagu nyaudo yaha asibiti ɓe laramo be tabbitina ko damatamo hiddeko be hokka mo lekki ngam ommoɗa.

Dereke'en tati ɓeɗo  ɓorni riga irin gotel be salla ɓalejum irin gotel ɓeɗo fija langa ha leddi  hasera maɓɓe bo nda himɓe  ɗo lara ɓe ɓeɗo fija on gam ɓe dimba balli maɓɓe ɓe bo ɓe holla bawal maɓɓe.
Agogo, be ɗan-kunne, be awarworo pat ɗon ɗo jeri. Agogo mai ɗon je worɓe ɗon je roɓe pat ɓeɗo waɗa ngam paune bo ngam ɓe lara wakkati.
Debbo ɗo joodɗi gaasa maako mooraama ngoɗka feere ɓe ngirlika ka ɗo haa dow, ngoɗka feere jimmitir heedi hoɓɓudu maako, ngoɗka feere jimmitir heedi balbe maako o ɗo waati ''vest'' daneejum.
Broshe faune ɗo naftira be majum on ha faunugo yeso debbo takanasma wakkati nde goɗɗo wati fauda se wo’’ina be majum.
Kwakwa manja ha totton ɓe heɓata nyebbam manja, ɗo fuɗa on haa leggal, ɓe ɗo nyama ɗum bannin, ɗo mari kwakwo haa nder mai to ɓe nyami ɓe pusi, ko kuma ɓe ɗo waɗa takai ɓe mai.
Maadi mannga ɗum jamanu, alaama holli ba balbal kuugal on nden ɓe ɗo fawni babal may bee fulaawaaji ni voɗugo nden babal may boo ɗon koltaya haa babal may nden nda hiite to jemma waɗi.
Nyebbam tingere, ɗo nder kwali maajum, debbo ɗo jogii ɗo zaani tingere ta’inga, be nanta ta'aka ɓeɗo yara nyebbam tingere, ngam lekki ndamba ɓe ɗo wuja haa ɓandu.
Pilaɗji nda famaro jo’ina nder mango, nda goɗɗi bo shirya ha sera bana ɗo o ɗo naftore ha rottuki nyamdu ha sare nyama, to nyamdu ɓendi himɓɓe de rotta ha pleɗji sei depo nyama ngam hara.

Furut salat ɗo hauti haa der koloba be moɓɓode jimum, ɗo youndi ndiri. Nonde koloba man danejun be maɓɓode man goldin kolo.
Atampa ɗo waali haa leddi, atampa ni ɗum kare rewɓe jey ɓe ɗo naftira bee maajum ngam nyoota suura banndu maɓɓe e nanta fawna.
Com haɗɗo nonde fere-fere bedo naftira be kumni ha safutuggo hore da kummai do mari nondi lemo green wodi pink wodi popul wodi balejum ha be green don haddo bedo safitira gasa’un be mai
Dotti en ɗidi ɓeɗo dari hauti jungo ɓeɗo ɓorni jompa be salla daneje be ifinere. Goto ɗo ɓorni jompa be gare danejum oɗo wati ifinere danejum be boɗejum oɗo wati darugal gite.
Gasa ni hunde on ɗum roɓe mari haje mum masin, kasi shappan e jenai  der temerre haje robe, ni ɗo mari haje gasa, kanju waɗi ɓe hakkilinta ka ɓe morata ka.

Dammugal get mannga nonde man daneejum bee ɓaleejum, dammugal bannin ɓe ɗo maɓɓita ba’anteeji nasta nder saree vurta, non boo himɓe ɗo tokka bee man irum dammuɗe bannin ɗo vo’ina saare bo ɗo vo’ina saare.

Jet kirim ɗum nyebbam gasa on, bote nyebbam gasa man bo ɗo juttina gasa, ɗo wo’ina gasa, ɗo ɗigginaka. Nden noni nyebbam man danejum faa ndu nyebbam man bo kolba on, mabbo de nyebbam man none man boɗejum.
Koromje ɗum ɓe andiri be royal ceyas. Ɓe ɗon naftira be maajum ha faunugo sare. Ɓe ɗo jooɗira be majum. Nda haɗɗoni ɗo jodi ha palo. Kolo koromje mai ni, ɗon pauda kolo, be nanta pink.
Nyamdu hander plat ɓe ɗo he’ini dum kabej, ɓe ɗo he’ini ɗum Karas, ɓe ɗo defi, nda ɗum ɗo vodi ɓe ɗo resi chokali. Min ɗo nyama nyiiri ngam ittugo velo.
Briats morɗi on morɗi voɗinga, burna pat bo be attachment bana banni on be wati attachment ɗo ɗo ɓedda gasa on a soda gasa mai a bedda ɗum be je maɗa, heɓa ɗum ɓedda jutugo, ɗum ɓedda waltugo.
Debbo o ɗo dari ɓari mahol je mari nonde ɓokko ɓokko, o ɗo wati toggo riga ping be sarla nonde bulak o ɗo jala, ha do mako ɗon boro ɗo ɓili.

Saare maunde viyetede gidan sama. Ɓe ɗo nyiɓa nde timaaka, nda dammuɗe haa sera, nda goɗɗe fere haa yeso totton da bo seraji mai ɓe tiggi juɗeeji ɗon ko ɓe yiɗi ɓe ɓedda yniɓugu.
E do jodi da gasaji ha hore mako gasaji mai do juti ha wari balbe mako, bedo naftira be gasa ha morugo bedo naftira be gasa yaha salun be wada pakin bedo naftira be gasa
Lanta ɗum ɗo haskora hiite, ɓe ɗo waɗa chaaji maga, gaɗo naftora be hiite lantarki waɗa chaaji, ɓe ɗo haskira ga hiite, ɗum ɗo haa nder kwali majum.
Kantawal silugo paɗeeji ɗo dari haa kona suudu, dow maaga woodi paɗeeji rooɓe kalakalaji, be paɗeeji worɓe, booro daneewo ɗo jooɗi haa dow, be defte. Haa leddi bo woodi paɗe silipasje ɗiɗi ɗo jooɗi.
Dow laawol buwaangal, baburji guda ɗiɗi, himɓe ɗo haa dow maajum, gooto ɗo loowi kare daneejum, gooto ɗo lowi kare ɓokko ɓokko, mootaaji bos, be jaamu amalanke.

Debbo do jogi kare zanugo do zana hundeji ko mari ha je ha mahol dum bo jude mako don lobbiti be nanta ko o faunirta mai, dum hauti be koloji fere fere bodejum, danejum, zargina, yelo be nanta luttudum.
Sare ɗum nyibala on je zamanu. Be nyibi be waɗi je ɗow be waɗi dammuɗe je zamanu gam faunuki sare majum. Ɗen kanjum ɗo. Babal on je goɗɗo joɗata siutina yonki mako. bei ko nanɗi bei man.
Tattase kala tati. Nda yelo, nda boɗejum nda girin. Ɓeɗo  naftira be mai ɓe defira nyamdu, ko be nyama keccum nonnon ha nder salad, ko be waɗira piza, ko stew, ko hunde fere.

Pellel nyamande e nanta siwtare, ɓi adama ɗo yilla pellel ji ɗo ngam nyama ko mari haje ha ko larani nyiri, nyamdu, be nanta jaram, ko larani ndiyam, leemu, fanta, be nanta ko mari haje, ha jongitiri ko ɓi adama yiɗi be nanta siutare ha nokkure man.

Ɓinngel peetel, o ɗo jooɗi ha dow daago, o ɓorni "riiga" daneejum.  O ɗo waati "sarƙa" ha daande maako, nden o ɗo moori hoore maako cukuu bee yeesooji. Gaasa maako ɗo ɓalwi, gaasa maako juutay "soosey".
Tasau samira be maɓɓode maago be nanta fanka ha sera maago. Ɗum ɗo naftira be maago on ha watugo hunde takanas ma nyamdu, e'ma goɗɗi kujeje ngam yarana goɗɗo.
Modetekon capsol. Beɗo namtira be mako on ha modugo. Ndembo nyauda goddo ha dau nyau dum daa mata dum. Ɗumɗo hokkaki on ha asibitiji gam nyaundugo goddo nder jaudum.

kuusel ta'inga ha nder tire, worɓe ɗiɗi ɗo joogi ɗum. Gooto nder worɓe man ɗo joogi laɓi ha juuɗe maako, gooto man bo ɗo joogi hunduko tire man. Kusel ni ɗo maari nafu ha ɓandu sosei ɗo ɓeddina goɗɗon njamu be nanta purotin.
Yimɓe fijirde lamu ndonndonu ɓe ɗon waɗa eh boksin, mana ɓeɗo ɓorti ɓeɗo wati sotnikaji ɓeɗon lukkindira ko'e maɓɓe, nda himɓeji ɗon mofti tari ɓeɗo hellana ɓe.
Set basket ɓe ɗo sora dum ha lumo den ta nafu majum kanjum ɓe ɗo naftira be majum be resa kareji, taka nasma kareji ɓikkoi woɓɓe bo ɗo naftira be man be joga nyamdu be yarana goɗɗo.

Silin ɗum katako ko ɗum pii oo pi, hunde on ɗum ɗo watta ha dow hoore suudu, suudu ndu ni ɗo mari pii oo pi be nanta hiite-hiite ha sera maajum, woodi hiite bo ha chaka ngam pii oo pi man ɗo mari faune, nden bo woodi goɗɗum fere ha ɓandu hedi sera ha ɓandu bongoru, be nanta dammugal be laabule ha les eesi man.
Geleji ngam ɗi ɗuɗɗi nda ɗi ɗo ni nondi kala kala  ɗo hutinirei ha sudduki ma bo ha vakkuki e rewbe e ɓukkoi e buduje kamɓe naftirta be geleji.
Ɓiɗɗo debbo, o do fauni joɗi waɗi sarka ha daa nde mako inanta nangi gasa mako voinika, gasa kanti ɗum andura atachimen, o do wati hunde ha daubana rivon.

Shago tela: Nda rigaji ɗo ɓili haa shago tela ɓe nyooti, ɓe ɓili ɗouko jaumi on wara ho'a. Tela ni ɗo nyoota limse roɓe  be worɓe fu, ɓeɗo nyoota sarla be riga, ɓeɗo nyoota gudel be riga, ɓeɗo nyoota riga be siket, ɓeɗo nyoota rigaji juɗɗi.
Riga juɗɗum be gele nda paɗe ji roɓe hasare man ha der chago kare roɓe ɗo naftira be man ɓe ɗo wata ha ɓandu maɓɓe gam surungal, heɓa ɓe voɗa do paɗe ha kosɗe fu man ɓeɗo waɗa ɗum ngam paune.

Kusel wulinga, ɓe ɗo rufiningel tingere be yaji, en ɗo ƴakka kusel ngam en ittina hunduko men suno, ndendenta bo en ɗo defa kusel ha hako nyama, en ɗo sa’a kusel ƴakka ngam ɗo nafa men ha ɓandu sosai.

Yeriji be Sarqa ɗo sili ha nder containa maji. Roɓe naftorta ɗum be ngaɗa ha noppi maɓɓe,  ɓe ngada sarqa bo ha dande maɓɓe, ɓe faunuro ɗum be bedda woɗuki.
Lipgulos, debbo ɗo jogi ɗum, haa juuɗe mum guda nayi, lips ni, rowɓe ɗo naftira ɗum, ɓe ɗo waata haa kunduɗe maɓɓe, ngam ɗo vo’itina pawne maɓɓe, to ɓe fawni hunnduko yoorata.

Goɗɗo on ɗo dari ɗo waati paɗe salla be riga ndaneha salla ɓeleha, oɗo dari kombi suudu nda sera suudu mai nda ɓe takki hunde feere je hollata ɗume we watta ha suudu mai, nda lawol ɗo saliri serani hanko bo oɗo dari joogi hunde ha nder leda.
Leeso, ɓe ɗo waala dow may,  ɓe jooɗa dow may, ɗo fawna suudu. Ɓe ɗo siga ɗum haa hootel, haa saare hoɓɓe, law haala nafturki ɗo pitillaaji ɗo haski pilooji eo maati.
A ku nonde leɗɗe ɗo dari ha dau leggal aku ni ɗum dabbawa on,, ɗum colli do dure ha sare nden do volwa.
Nder salum babal wo’itunke hore roɓe, ɓeɗo lotaka, ɓeɗo yornaka, ɓe dasan ɓe moran, nda gasaje a taciman ɗo ɓili nda wodi riga fere ɗo ɓili hadow jamdi.
Kofi je jamanu, ɓeɗon naftara be irin kofi jamanu ɗo on ha sare gam yargo ndiyam, gari, soɓo, konunzaki, be sha’i.
"Gwanda" ɗum hunde on nyametede den bo ɗum ɓiɓɓe leɗɗe on belde marde nafu ha band enu adama do nyama ɗe on to ɗe settama kecce ɗe ngalaa defe.
Koromje ɗe bodɗe Masin,ɗe ɗo jeri ha nder Paloru du. Koromje man nonde maje Burawun be mili Kolo be ash kolo .Wodi tebul ha shaka Palo man ha hakkunde Koromje majum tebul man Kanjum ma burawun'on.
sho vel. Ɓe ɗo naftira gam hutungo be majum. Ɓe ɗo nyedira leddi be majum  ɓe ɗo naftira gam jiɓugo siminti, Lebura'en ɗo naftira ha wakkoti kugal maɓɓe, nokka siminti e nanta njarendi jiɓa.
Almakaci kuje on  je ɓeɗo neftradum ha taugo hundeji irin  kwali, ledda, kare, tela en on naftiroɓe be majum ɓe tairta yadi be trumiji heba ɓe yorira  be majum.

Ɓingel debbo, nda ɗum ɗo jungo maako o ɗo waati halagaare. Kooli mako bo peɗeli mai, o ɗo waati penti totto, o ɗo penti jan farshe. Peɗeli mako mai ɗo juuti. Ɓe ɗo naftira be zobe hala paune, woɓɓe fere bo ɗo naftira be maajum wakkati ɓangal. Ɓe ɗo wanna peɗeli maɓɓe penti mai on nga haala paune kanjum ma vooɗa bannin.
Kumji, haa nder ledaaji kesi pil je choggu. Ɓe ɗo naftira kum haa safutuggo gaasa hore ngam ka ɗigga, ka walta.
Tummude: Ɓeɗo naftira be tummude on ha sare, ɓeɗo watira kosam ha nder, ɓeɗo be wata be cobbal, ɓeɗo jiɓira kurori ha sare, ɓeɗo lotira marori fu ha sare, nda horde ɓeɗo yarira be mai.

Payanɗe loope, payanɗe loope ni, ɓe ɗo maha ɗum on be loope, ɓe fawna ɗum, woɓɓe fere ɗo tigga looɗe man ngam waɗan ndiyam, woɓɓe fere ɗo defira be payankon man, woɓɓe fere ɗo waɗira asuusu, be ko laarani be man.
Na'ie none fere-fere, den maudi e pamari ha nder ladde. Be leɗɗeji, na'ie bo ɗum dabbaji on mauɗi den nyametedi.
Sakiraaɓe ɗo mofti haa daldal  fijugo bol kosɗe, ɓe ɗo mofti laara gooto fi´i  bol maajum, kanɓe bo, ɓe ɗo dari, gooto be gooto waran fija.
Sandiks ɗo vinɗi maikoro. Ɗum memori on je be lowata ha waya ko ha kompiuta ngam be shiga be aɗina hundeji ha totton. Be aɗina hunɗe marɗe bote pat nder maju. Ngam to be ummi dabutugoni be he’ba.
Zebraji kanji ɗiɗi ɗiɗo dilla, ha nder ladde, ɗon mo mba’antewa marnga kosɗe nayi ɗo ha ɓaawo maaji.
tus manjagaragu ɗo ɗari guɗa ɗiɗi. Nda burɗi majum je jamɗi, Nda chebur ɗo bo ɗon chebur man kanjumni ɗo mari nyi'a nyi'a on. Nda jamɗi fere bo ɗo ɗari ɗo tari be boggiji hunɗuko on ɗon bodejumni.
Sarka ɓe ɗankunne be zobe robe, roɓe ɗo faunira  ɓe majum,ɓeɗo wata sarka ha dande ɓe wata yeri ha noppi, ɓe wata zobe ha jungo maɓɓe, to ɓe fauni ɓeɗo wata ɗum ɗo voɗi na ɓe.
Moftorde ɓukkoy siyasa ɓedo mofti woɓɓe ɗo hosa ɓe hoto oɗo oɗo hokka jawaabi ko moy bo ɗo de’iti, gam heɗi tiki ko o wi'a taɓe, nda woɓɓe haa to ɓe ɗo ɓamti juɗe.
Fe’an worɓe guda tati, ɗiɗo ɗo ɓorni limse danejum be gareji ɓe ɗo hufni kufuneji, goto bo o ɗo wati jompa be hufunere o ɗo feɗi gogul ha yeso riga mako.
Yeri be nanta halagare ɗo naftire ngam Paune, ɗo naftire ha Sare ha kolarani Paune, ɗo naftire ha Pellel Kuugal ,roɓe ɗo waɗa ngam Paune maɓɓe.
Jaule kuɗa ɗiɗi, ɓe ɗo ɗura . jaule ni ɓe ɗo wurna ɗum ha sare. Nɗen do wona ha leɗɗe. Be ɗo naftira ɓe jaule ɓe ɗo nyama ɗo mari nafu masin ha ɓanɗu
Tutawal lesdi Senegal, gol ɗo mari nonde tati, wodi boɗejum, wodi oli, wodi bo boko bokko, nden wodi kodere balere ha chaka tutawal man, do holla alama lesdi Senegal.
Sabulu je lotugo ɓandu, sabulu man ɓe ɗo lotira ɓandu on be majum, kanjum ɗo ɗo valla ɗiggina ɓandu, den bo elkina ɓandu, ɓe ɗo naftira ɗum on ɓurna pat jemma.
Debbo o ɗo dari o ɗo ɓorni limse mako brawn ha ɓandu limce man ɗon paune goldin kolo o ɗo wati sarka mako goldin be toɓɓere boɗejum gele mako brawn o fotti masin o ɗo takki lalle ha koli mako.

Kuitaje ɓe ɗo awa ɗe ha sera wuro gam ƴakkugo, bo ɓe ɗo kauta be yaaji ngam be ƴakka, woɓe bo ɗo ƴakka ɗe jorɗe bana ni tan, a tawan worɓe ɗon ƴakka rewɓɓe bo ɗon ƴakka, mawɓe do ƴakka, pamar ɓe bo ɗon ƴakka.
Ɗerkejo, ɗo wati riga ɓe sallah. Oɗo wati ɓutt. Oɗo vakki ɓoro. Sera mako ɗon get. Sera get mai ɗon mahol ɗanejum. Yesomako ɗon goɗɗo ɗo wara. Sera goɗɗo mai ɗon mota.
Stapilesar ɗo joɗi ha dow korwal, ɓe ɗon naftora dum ha hauruki fridch ngam ɓedda sembe hite ɗum fewa, ɓe ɗon haurana tivi ngam ta hite warta ɗum wula.

Paɗe faɗugo guda ɗiɗi, ɓe ɗo sigi haa dow babal boɗeejum ,ɓe ɗo haɓɓi ɗum  kosɗe ɗiɗi man.Paɗe man ɗo mari ndiyam leddi,booɗɗe.Ɓe ɗo naftira paɗe, ɓe faɗa, ngam ɓe yaha babal to goɗɗo yiɗa nawna kosɗe maako.
Asbinaaga ha leddi ma bo ɓokko ɓokko nga ɓe asbinta ha leddi ko ɓe awa ngam ɓe itta ɓe defa ɓe nyama nda leggal mbai ɗo sera majum kanjum fu ɗum pat hako nyamugo on.
Alluha gengal nda ɗum, ɗum maanga ɓe ɗo waati hotooji moota, Keke napep, bee nanta mashin mardum taya ɗiɗi, woodi boo galon nyebbam, ɗo on hollata talla nyebbam ɓe watta ɗum ba’antee ɗum naftirta.

"Wayna" nyaamdu on jey en nanata suuno may, en tamsa, en nyaama. Ndenndenta bo "wayna" ɗoo en anndi bee mbay on ɓe waɗirta, to en heɓi mbay may, hanju on en woggata, en ɓiɗɗa ndiyam may en waɗa "hadi" men en tamsa en nyama.

gortode nadde ni bido tawade ha ladde on na bana gotode nomal je wonjata ha caka liwbe ha sare hotode maide buri walgora yomanti on ha ladde de subta ko shafi nyamdu irin su kowe be gauri be funandiama
Yonde saare lamu ena nastorde sare majum ɗum ɗo naftira be sare majum ngam sigaago lamlamɓe ɓe mari lamuji ɗi gargajiya.
Makaroni, ɗo nder leda ɗo sawidum nder leda. Leda may bo do mari kolo orench be kolo danejum. Makaroni mai bo ɗi ɗo nder paket ji tuɗdum.

Jungo ɓingel debbo be paune lalle ɓe ɗo zani didi flawaji be pedeli mako juɗɗi, be jawe mako, be halagare ha kolel mako. Ɓe ɗo waɗa zane lalle on ngam vodinaɓe bannin halagare be jawe bo ɓe ɗo wada ngam paune on.

Diɗo dimashiji on je bi adama naftirta ngam huki kude hite, do don naftira hunɗe on je woggata katako ta’ata katako ta’ata ledɗe heɓa bi adama naftira di ɗido kareji on je naftirta be hite ngam bi adama huwira ha wakkati kugal mako.

Caago on jey ɓe sorrata boorooji, boorooji vakkugo rooɓe, ɗo mari nonnde  kala -kala, ɗo mari dizaayin kala-kala ɓe ɗo naftira  booro ngam  vakkugo ɗo nder ko rooɓe fawnirta. Ɓooro ɗo vo’ina pawne debbo.

Met ɗo joɗi ha dou Kwali. be bokotiji be roba ha ɓanduma.Ɗon roba je ɓili ha dou bokotimai.Net ɗo bo ɓe ɗon naftira be man'on ha Lirugo Kare. Ɗon kolo ɓokoko ɓokko, ɗon Orensh,ɗon boɗejum ɗon bulu.Ɓe ɗon naftira ɗum hato kare  do’an se ɓe Nangira.ɗon ha dou Kwali, bokotiɗo Danejum gotel Roba ɗobo Danejum be Mabɓode Bodejum.
Mordi: robe do mora gasa mabbe mordi kala kala ngam be voda. Nden bo be naftira be attachment ngam be bedda jutugo gasa mai. Nden bo be chanjina gasa mabbe mai kolo.

Tuutawal leddi, tuutawal ɗo naftire haa wakkatiiji feere-feere, wakkatiiji hollata himɓe ɗo ceewa nda ɗo on babal ɗo ko nufata, nda daraja maari, nda koɗi nufata, nda ɗo ko ɗum hollata. Tuutawal ɗo naftiri haaje haaje kala- kala be gureeji duuɗɗi ɗum ɗo holla nda ɗo on wure kazaare, nda ɗo wure kazare.

Fulawa, kala mo yiɗi vo'i tunngo saare maako pat, ko kuma haa o joɗata, to ofis maako. Kotoy himɓe ɓurna pat, yiɗi ɓe waata fulawaji ɗo, ɓe aawa ɗum. To a yahi soodugo fu a taway ɓe sorrini ma haa buhu, ngam to a warti saare, heɓa a annda no a ittata ɗum daga buhu may, a waata haa leddi.
Himɓe fijoɓe bol, ɓe ɗo waɗi kare maɓɓe boɗejum be daneejum, goto on tan waɗi riga maako girin be daneejum, oɗo jogi bol majum, ɓe pat maɓɓe ɓe ɗo ɓorni paɗe.
Yonde sare mahol juɗɗum, dammugal ɗiɗi mili kolo, gotel jamdi jamdi mili kolo, gene ɗo ha totton, lambatu ha sera dotti ha sera, baranda juɗɗum.
Sare maunde der hidama ɗo mari dammuɗe petel guda gotel ha kombi gotel ha sera ni,  ɓe ɗo penti danejum chaka man ɗo mari windo guda ɗiɗi ɓedo wadi jamɗe ha windo man ha yasi man bo ɗon mari colbert.

Duroowa on musamman ɓe waɗi ngam je ngam sigugo padeeji. Ɓe ɗo jeeri paɗe ha sera maajum, ɓe ɗo taiti ɗiɗi ha dow may, ɗon booro ɓaleejum ɗon leppol ɓaleejum haa dow too ɗo, ɓe ɗo jeeri koofiiji bee luttuɗum paɗe ɗon haa sera maajum. Ɗon kaapet ɓe ɗo naftira bee irin duroowa ɗoo ngam sili pade

Ɓukkoy worɓe ɗo dari, gooto "mehangulos tii shet" daneejum, sarla "buluu". Gooto bee daaroogal ha gite "tii shet" daneejum e sarla ɓaleejum, nde ɓinngel debbo ɗo dari ha sera maako, ɗo waati junngo ha keesi e gaasa ɓaleejum.

Ɓeɗo siwa sobo, non bo kadi sobo ɗo waɗiri e kuje ɗuɗɗe, woɓɓe fere ɗo naftoro hako follere, ɓe ngaɗa sobo, woɓɓe bo ɗo soda kuje mai ha chagoji on ɓe naftorol bano no jamanu warri, den bo sobo ɗum hunde on nde yimɓe jarata to ha dollinde, ko bo to sopmi de be ndiyam.
Fanka ɓe ɗo naftoro nga ha paloji, ko ha ofisji, nga ɗo nafa ha ittugo guldum, kolo ma nga danejum be ɓalejum.
Moota tanka jey watugo ndiyam ndaa kolo maajum danejum be ɓaleejum,ɗo vinndi wata haa ɓanndu tanka maajum tayaji man bo ɓleejum ndiyam on, hebbini haa nder tanka man.
Ɗo omo on, omo ɗo ɓe ɗo naftira ɗum, gam ɓe loota kare, ko ɓe laiɓa taasaaje.
Mota manga do dari je adugo kare, be do wati mashin ɗuddum ha dumai les maibo mashin ji’on do dari be do naftira be mashin ya ha yidi fu do naftira petur.

Tacha motaji. Ɗon bo wobɓe ɗon jodi nɗer motaji pikop. Nɗabo motaji mauɗi kosoji na'i ɗabbaji bo ɗon ɗari,wato tiralaji. Nɗa bibbe rewbe bo ɗiɗo be ɗon dilla talla mabbe,be ɗo ngaɗa ko moi fu beko ronɗi,enanta bo himar mboɗei-mboɗei.
Deftere jangugo dina islama, ɗo wallita masin ha hokkugo goddo bososel andugo dina islama, denbo andal boddum masin hako larani dina gam ɗo hokka godɗo bososel doggungo kudeje mum bana no mara haaje.
Ɓiɗdo debbo,  oɗo joɗi wakki boro mako, oɗo wati toggowol ɓalewol, ɓe mori mo gasa mako be zare juɗɗum, ɗo rufiti ha ɓawo mako, gasa ni ɓedo faunira be majuum, be iri morɗi ayidi fuu.
Tadatowo oɗo dari oɗo suddi yeso mako, oɗo ɓorni riga mako be sallah be paɗe o juɗɗo juɗe mako be bindigaru o maɓɓi yeso mako ɗum hosi hoto man on bo daga hore mako ha waru go kosɗe mako.
Ɓikkon leɗɗe on ɗo, nɗaa ɗi ɗo ɓe ɗo nyaama ɗum daga leemu, apul on ɗo, ndaa girebs, ndaa ɗo goyva on. Ɓe ɗo nyaama ɓikkon leɗɗe soosay, ngam mari amfani a ɓanndu.
Biddo debbo! odo fauni dari, odo habbi dan-kwali mako ni vodugo, o wadi a setta, nanta odo mabbiri yeso mako bo be emoji. Min larai yeso kam. Odo moji gele mako bo ha da'nde. Debbo mai danejo on.

Shago soorugo indomi. Indomi ni ɓurna fu ɓe ɗo defina ɓikkoi to dillan makaranta, mauɓe mai ma ɗo wawa nƴama indomi. Indomi mai do shiryi-shiryi haa shago soorugo. Indomi mai ɗo windi indomi cikin haa dow maajum.

Tattashe hunde hako'on,ɓe ɗo Naftira be mai ha waɗugo hako kala kala.Ɓeɗo waɗa sitiu be mai,ɓeɗo waɗa jolof ha Nyiri be mai,ɓe ɗo waɗa ha hako Follere, ɓe ɗo waɗa  hako ɓokko. Ɓeɗo naftira be mai ha kuje Kala kala. Tattashe mai ɗo dirɓi lowi ha taso.
Ɗow babal sutare'on, ɓeɗo wara siuta totton soda nyamateɗum, be hunɗe jarete ɗam ha babal majum.
Mota manga je mari launi geraɗe ɗo mari taya launi ɓalejum min ɗo naftira be mota ɗo ha wasugo bohol be wauru.

Supageti manɗa talia be ɗeefi ɗo nɗer fa'anɗi timmini be benɗugo. Bo luttini goɗdo waɗɗa pilet nyeda nyaama ɗa taliya man be uni tattase,attarugu,tingeje ena luttuɗukare hako. fuu ɗo ha nder man benni sai nyamgo tan lutti.
Ilalal ɗum lesdi goote nder lesɗe duniya. Ilalal mai ni ɗo mari launu guda ɗiɗi. Grin be nanta daneejum. Ɓe ɗo didi koode benanta lewru nder nonde boɗejum.

Alluwa gengal ɓe ɗo darni ha dau lawol, goɗɗo  ɗo sala oɗo  vakki boro mako. Ha alluwa gengal manni ɓeɗo  zani roɓɓe ɓe ɗiɗo ɓe ɗo jogi waya ɓe ɗo lara.

Jungo goɗɗo ɗo jogi kontena daneejum. Haa nder kontaina mai ɗon tattaase manga-manga guda ɗiɗi. Inde maajum bel pepe, ɗon ba tattaase on amma kala mai yelo on. Ɓe ɗo waata on gam ɓe faunira nyamdu ɓe urna nyamdu, ɓe ɗo waata haa jolof.

Hotoyel ɓiɗɗo debbo e pawne mordi, e mo mori morɗi mo hauti mordiɗin iga yeso ɓawo warti o hauti ɗum ha chaka hore mako, non bo era were sera o mori o dirtini edi wakkere nyamo e nano, omo borni kare toggore yelo.
Laabi ndiyam, watu lambatu. Ndiyam ɗo tokka, dotti ɗo sala, vo’itina lawol, do vo’itina birni ɗon kolvati ha yeso ɗon leddi boɗejum ha sera, e gene fudi ha yeso.

Tumatirje hander kondoje tingere do rufi ha leɗɗi, sorowo tumatir do sukli wo’ina tingejemum, goɗɗo bo do sera do taskiti to tumatirje ,da goɗɗo do jodi do mba’antewa machin goɗɗo bo do dari hokkiti bawo to do pat doder lumo on.
Nyembam wujugo ha hunduko je roɓe  donaftira be may ɓe fauna.
Leda bredi be madara kawbel, be leda milo be do naftira be mai on ha hastigo fajiri ko nage goddo nyama hara sosai do harna do nafa bo ha bandu.

Kovi totton nonde kolo leddi ɗiɗon nonde ɓokko-ɓokko, ɗiɗon lemo girin, pilat nayon nonde leddi, kapet danejum nonde ɓalejum, tire nonde danejum.
Players ɗo fija ha filin bol, goto ɗo waɗi riga yele be sala ɓalejum, goto ɗo waɗi riga ɓalejum be sala ɓokko ɓokko, wodi woɓɓe bo ha ɓawo, man balal mai wodi gras capet ɗo tarni ɗum ɓe kowa gol.
Lekki moɗeteekon haa nder faandu, faandu man bo danewa. Lekkini ɓe ɗo naftira be maakon, ngam hebugo daama, to goɗɗoo nyawɗo, yaha likita foondi mo, hokka mo lekki.

Chago sorugo omoji, en ɗo naftira be omo ha lotugo limse men, ko kuma ha layɓugo, ɓeɗo  naftira be omo ha lotugo motaji, ko kuma machin, ko kekeji. Ɓe ɗo naftira be omo ha makaranta, ɓe ɗo lota ɓawo chuɗi, nonnon ha asbiti fu ɓe ɗo naftira be omo mai ha lotugo ɓawo chuɗi, be lotugo beshit ji asbiti.
Toggowol jungol ɗo sura ɓandu, ɓeɗo julira be majum ɓeɗo faunira be mai den den bo ɓeɗo nyota haa shago tela on, ɗo ɗo ɗum sampul.

Makaniki ɗo wo’itina mota. O ɗo jogi spaina ha jungo maako, o ɗo haɓɓa nod man na, o ɗo fista na, se Allah. O ɗo ɓorni kare o huwirta man, kare man bo jergina, blu. O ɗo laara masin no o wo'itinta mota man.
Ha restorant babal ɗum ɗun nyamuki nyamdu be yarunko njaram himɓe bo ɗowawa yaha restorant ngam joda heɓa de'itare yeuta geuti marɗum himmiɗinare.

Turmiji boddi mardu nonde fere-fere on jeri haddo babal on dum sorgo kare wato supamakets robe uni be andir be naftorgo be turmiji bedo nyota, bede soda yara lamar,  bede sodira bo wata ha kare bangal.
Yeri je guda ɗiɗi  ɗiɗo  nandindiri, yeri roɓɓe  on naftirta be man, ɓe ɗo  wata ha noppi maɓɓe ɓe ɗo  waɗa  ɗum  gam faune heɓa  ɓe fauna noppi maɓɓe ɓe  voɗa  fu man ngam faune ɓe waɗata.
Yalo be nanta gauta ɗum hunde on nyametede nden bo ɗum hunde on awate'nde. Ɗum ɗo nyama ɗum nden ɗum hunde suno on.
Goɗɗo ɗo jogi flower. Colour mai haako haako bee nanta purple. Woodi huunde feere daneejum daneejum haa dow haako mai. Ɓe ɗo vo’’itina saare bee maako, wobbe boo nder oofis.
Kofi be pilet majum je tangaran ɓe ɗo naftira be majum gam yarugo sha’i, ndananta buta ɓeɗo siwa shayi ha nder kofi man, gam heɓa ɓe yara, shaini ɗo mari nafu masin ha ɓandu.
Yonnde sare mar ɗum dammugal petel, ɓe ɗo waɗi pilesta saare mai gaba go'o hedi yasi. Dammugal saare mai nii ɗo mari nonɗe burowun, jauleru on haa dammugal saare man bako nastugo dessaare.

Ɓooye haa nder taasawo jey gilas, nda jok bee koofi jey gilas mai haa sera mai, ɓe ɗo heɓa ɗum on haa leggal, ɓe ɗon mura ɗum bani  koo kuma be sofna ɗum bee jooli jus ɓe yara, koo kuma ɓe waɗa jus booye bee mai bana jey woni haa nder koofi, ɗum ɗo mari vitaminji haa ɓanndu haa nder maajum.
Goɗɗo ɗo jooɗi titi kemera, goɗɗo fere ɗo jooɗi be nanta kiibot. O ɗo jogi maws ha dou korowal. Nda ɗum fanka ɗo dari ha sera maɓɓe ɓe ɗo jooɗi ha nder ofis, ɓe ɗo huwa.
Derke`en nayo ɗo dari, tati ɗo waɗi gaare, gooto bo waɗaya gaare, ɗo waɗi jompa tan. Ɓe pat maɓɓee ɗo waɗi kifineeje maɓɓe, ɓe haɓɓi agoogooji maɓɓe ɓe ɗo fawni.

Keke nyootugo je katako, unordu ɗo dari haa kombi mai. Keke kuujeji on, je ɓe waɗirta sana’a be mai. Roɓe be worɓe pat ɗo naftira haa waɗugo sana’a maɓɓe, nden-nden ta bo, ɓe ɗo naftira be keke haa nyotugo limseeji je en ɓornata.
Inji namugo, nonde man bulu enanta dak bulu ɓeɗoo naftira be inji ɗoni gam namugo butali, enanta gauri, nden ɓe ɗo dirɓira be majuum ɓe dirbira biriji.
Zane ha nder ililal dum (andira tutawal): dum zani alama hore goddo. Nda nyi’e, benanta alama gite, benanta kine. Dum wadi faune man ha nder launi ji kolo danejum, balejum, benanta goldin.
Defteree  jangugo, ɓe ɗo maɓɓiti gotel man, gotel man bo ɗo maɓɓi, ɗo jooɗii haa dao tebur  ɗo mari nonde boɗejum, ɓe ɗo naftira ngam jangugo, pukaraaɓe haa makaranta.

Ku e lekki ɗo rufi haa leddi, kala ndiyam gooro, feere boo ɗo lutti haa nder faandu mai, ɓe ɗo naftira bee ndiyam ɓe moɗa lekki ɓe ɗo moɗa lekki ni ngam ɓe nyawndira nyawu koo bye fadda nyawu ko kuma ɓe ɓedda vitamin haa ɓandu goɗɗo.
Sarga on be yeri nda ɗum ɗo kashi ɗiɗi on, yeri be sarga yeri be sarga nda ɗum ha nder kwaali maajum ɓe naftira be yeri ngam waatugo ha noppi sarga bo ɓe ɗo waata ha ndaande.
Shevur, diga enanta manjagara. Kare be hutinirta ɓeɗo naftira be shebur hanokkugo jarandi e nanta jibugo. Diga ɓe ɗo wasira, nden manjagara ɓe ɗo vuwa be man.
Korwal be tebur durowaji ɗo wakkere dow tebur man, wodi darogal be flower kare paune roɓe do naftoro ɗum ha nder chuɗiji mabbe be joɗo ɓe fauno.
Kare nafturgo kuɗe kicin nda cocaliji nda cokali ɓofturgo hunde to goɗɗdo do sa’i,  nda kare kuɗeji ɗo nafa sosai ha kicin to goɗɗdo  ɗo huwira ɓodɗum sosai.

Haɓirte ɗi kare komin naftirta zamanuji ande andiraɗum be not dum don wana ha bandu jamdeji ba’ante di andiradum ben mota mardun kosde nay, be mashin keke nape mardun kose tati, be keke dum don wona ha kujeji duɗɗum ko min naftirta hande e jango ɗum do valla ha jokiki hakkunde jamdi e jambi.
Goɗɗo ɗo dari penta, ngam vo'ungo babal. O ɗo penta ni fulawaji kala-kala, o ɗo penta ɗum o zaana kala-kala haa ɗo. O waɗi kala penti mai bo, fulawa ɓaleejum, o zaani. Nda bob bo ha sera mai.
Deftere jangugo. Ɗo naftire be mare on ha jangugo. de nbo ɗum deftere on windaɗe gam hokkugo goɗɗo bo sosela andugo kujeji goɗɗi fere nyukiniɗi ɗi andaka.
Dereke en ha babal fijugo bol ɓeɗo joɗi rena lara derɗiraɓe maɓɓe ɗo fi’a to ɗon mo nauni ko mo ɓe vurtini goto nasta.

Goɗɗo  gorko oɗo  dari oɗo  haɓɓi metelewol ha dow hore mako oɗo  ɓorni  alkebbare mako daneju nden goɗɗo  fere bo ɗo dari ha wakkere mako be limse ndoɗɗa ndoɗɗa ɓeɗo watani mo bolwirɗum ko hosata sautu volde ha dande mako kuje biye teɗum maik.
Yonde sare marga dammugal maunde, nda ɓeɗo waati wayaji haa dow mahol sare man.

Derke'en tati ɓe ɗo haɓa vo’ungo pellel je ɓe waɗata ivent. ɗa ɓolom ɓolomji ɗa leppi ha amariya joɗata. 
ko kuma to goɗɗo wadai ɓaɗɗe hayata o joɗa ɗa korowal.

Himɓɓe ɗo sala ha dou lawol, nda napep guda ɗiɗi, gotel ha jungo nyamo, gotel ha jungo nano, mo woni jungo  nyamo ɗo, ɗo waɗa reverse wato oɗo Lora ɓawo, mo woni jungo nano bo ɗo dari pellel gotel,  himɓɓe fere be kosɗe, fere be keke, mo woni jungo  nyamo ɗo, ɗon goɗɗo fere ɗo vayi keke ha ɓawo mako hosi kare, nda alluha’el fere ɓe ɗo waɗa  talla hala jangirde nca program al fajer college of education.
Biskit ɗo joɗi ha babal Sorrugo mai.Ɓe ɗon ƴakka ɗum bannin ɓe ɗon Yarira be ti,ɓe ɗo yarira be Sobo, Kunu ɗum ɗon harna.
Yeri be sarka, zobe, be hunde juuɗe jey waatugo rowɓe. Ɓe ɗo fawnira be maajum.
Saare maadi jamanu ɓe ɗo fawni nde, dammugal man dammugal gilas, ɗo mabbiti, windo, gilas gootel ɗo maɓɓiti, ɓe ɗo fawni waɗi penti ash kolo nden hiite boo ha ɗon haa sera.
Ɗo ɗum ɓikkoy makaranta on, ɓeɗo wati inifon irin gotel, ɓeɗo ɓamti juɗe, woɓɓe maɓɓe ɗo wati fesin kap.
Mbai nyamdu on je nyamuki, ɓeɗo ira ha leddi to ɓendi irta, ɗoo defe mbai nyama, ɗo wade kurori mbai, ɗo wada hako majun fu ɗo defira ngam nyama
Ɗo on larata ɗo tebur on ɓe ɓari ha dammugal dan tebur man ɗo mari nafu kerol ha sare, ɓeɗo jiɓira loope, ɓeɗo  jiɓira simenti, ɓeɗo ɓoftira doɗɗe  ha katane ɓeɗo  boftira salte fere fere.
Nokkure ɓe sorata kusel wulinga be gortugal wulinga. ɓeɗo sora ha dau lawol, himɓe do wara soda nyama ha ton, kokuma wata ha tek awe dillida, ɗeɗo mari nafu masin ha ɓandu nyamugo man.
Ɗankunne , dankunneni roɓe on ɗo naftira be mai ha wadugo paune, ɓe ɗo faunira be mai ɓeɗo fala ha noppi.
Saare on ɗo, naa saare maadi ndaa barannda, ndaa  fulawaaji, ndaa fulawa bot ɗo jooɗi. Ɓe ɗo aawi fulawaaji maajum, haa geefe ɓe penti saare may ɗo vooɗi, himɓe ɗon jooɗa, nder saare may.
Jammbaaki kare pawne on jey rooɓe, ndaa ɗum don boɗeejum bee ndiyam hanta, ɓe ɗo naftira bee maajum ɓe ɗo fawna ɓe ɗo waata hunnduko maɓbe jey nonnde ɓe yiɗi fuu laata bannin.
Filaks, ɗo ɓe ɗo naftira be maajum haa ci'eeji, to ɓe dolli ndiyam ngulɗam ɓe ɗo waata haa nder maajum ngam taa ndiyam mai feewa, nonnon sha'i koo Gaari pat ɓe ɗo waata haa nder filaks man.

Moftorde on ɓe waɗi ɗum himɓe mawɓe-mauɓe ko laarani harka siyaasa, o ɗo ndaa mo ɗo ardi waati gaare daneejum, oɗo waati bo daarogal ɓaleejum, be nanta hifnere, mo woni ɓaawo maako ma ɗo waati gaare on, amma je maako nonde maako mai bulu, o ɗo waati hifnere bulu, kanko ma daarogal gite maako ɓaleejum.
Korowal jonde ha palo ɓeɗo  joɗi ni ɗum ha pellel fiwugo koromje,  lutti ɗi ɗo sawi nder ledda ɓeɗo naftira be mai ha joɗugo.

Ɗammugal sare. Get mai ɓalejum. Mari nonɗe ɗanejum les mai ɗon lamɓatu. Ɓaɓal mai waɗi ɗotti sosai. Tails mai ɗo ɓakkiti ɓakkiti. Lamɓatu mai ɗo mari kujeji yaɓɓutuggo. Ɗon gene fuɗi ha sera mai. Ɗow sare mai ɗon waya elektirik chok.

Leeso nda durowaji haa sera man, ɗo hoore leeso man on, ɓe ɗo ve’ita haa shuɗi ngam walugo haa doo man fauna, nda ɓo durowaji ɗo ɓe ɗo siga defte haa sera mai, maabo hite je haskata suudu, ɓe ɗo siga ni kofiru ndiyam haa do man.
Taso ɓe paranti majum lomɓiɗiri joɗi, plate je watugo nyamɗu taso je watugo hako ɗo leɗɗi.
Mangoro benduɗe ɓeɗo iti sigi, nda ɗeɗo ɗiɗo boji ɓeɗo naftira be mangoro ɓe nyama nden ɗo vallita masin ha bandu.

Dammugal sare be fulawaji nda dusbin ɗo dari ha yasi hunde rufugo bola on to ɓe ɓofti bola ɓe wara ɓe rufa ko bo to himɓɓe ɗo sala yari ndiyam sakkina, ɓeɗo naftira be man ha yonde nda geneji ha leddi nda ɓe waɗi fensin bo be karafuna.
Paalo do we’iti jerny koromge bodde, don mari woflerde petel- petel nonde  golden, don mari labuleji do habbi, do mari yate lantarki bob hado silim maga, do mari styce.

Bairoje ɗo jodi haa nder kwali majum. Nda kwalije mai guda nai, nda goɗɗi fere bo haa ɓaawo majum. Nda ɓe ɗo zaani hoto bairo mai. Inde bairo mai Big, big mai ni ɓuri bairo pat voɗugo haa nder bairoji. Ɓe ɗo vindira on bo be bairo haa deftere.
Kampaniwa sorugo motaji andiradi benanta toyota, kampaniwa man ɗon mari none ɗanejum, bindi boɗejum ha dou mahi man.
"Maɗi zamanu" dum gidan sama ɗo mari hawa guda tati be ɗo mahairin madiman a jangirle jami'a makaranta gam bukarabeya janga.
Ɗo ɗum ba’antewam nga ɓe hoosorta ba’anteji famari ɓe yaara ha babe feere.

Haako baygoore ɗo laya haa leddi be ɓikkoy may guda tati. Ɓe ɗo nyaama baygoore may,ɓe setta ɓe defa ,ɓe nyama bannin. Ɓe ɗo waɗa haako may bo, ɓe hawta be follere be alayyaho,ɓe lawta ko ɓe nyaama,ɓe ɗo defa haako may bo bannin tan himɓe nyaama.

Soɓo, hunde oun jei min naftira bee majum min sooda haa lumo min wara min hawtira soɓo ngam min nana Belɗum majum, min waɗa diyam majum heɓa naftira ngam min yara ɗum ɗon ɓedda njamu haa ɓandu  Ɓiɓɓe Aadama'en.
Booro min ɗo naftira be booro, min ɗo waata kare paune amin, jambaki, gazal, pauda, bairo, deftere, rooɓe naftirta be maji.

Pampasji ɗuɗɗi ɗo joɗi ha dow tebur ha shago, pampas ɓo ɗum kujeji on ɓe naftirta ngam ɓe sawa ɓikkoi ɓandu ɓikkoi, ɗum taɓan cofe ɓeɗo waɗana ɓikkoi ngam taɓa cofe ha ɓalli ɓikkoi.
Goɗɗo o ɗo jooɗi dow korowal ,o ɗo ɓorni limse maako, sarla be jompa .O ɗo waati agoogo be halagaare , jompa limse on jey fottinta worɓe sosay musamman to ɓe waati huula haa totton.
Ɓingel debbo. Oɗo yofti gaasa hoore maako ka o ɓedditi be gaasa kanti, ka moraaka, o lotika, o safitika, ka ɗiggi tilis, o yofitika les.
Zane onɗo. Nɗa ɗum be zani ɗebbo ɗo fauni. ɗa oɗo wati sarga irim je himbe nane onbo. Gam ɗa faune mako mai je himbe nane on. Oɗ wati yeri mako ɗa sarka mako ha ɗa'nɗe gefe mako ma zane ɗebbo mai on.
Ɗo dum biɗɗo gorko dari, o ɗon fauni be paɗe balewa be sarla balewa. O ɗon wati juude ha jiiba.
Leeso tiggaango be nantaa katiifa maago, ɗum ɗo naftira be maago on ha we'utuggo ngo ha suudu nden ngo ɗo wo'ina suudu masin, hokka goɗɗo bo bosesel waalugo ngam hisna goɗɗo waalugo ha leddi.
Horde, Goɗɗo don jogi horde ha juɗe mo, Horde ɓe ɗo yarira gari ɓe yaran ko sam be horde, ɓe do lanya be horde.
Ɗoo boo en laarata ɓe ɗo ƴowna ɗum "inhiila" on. "Inhiila" bo kuuje’on ɗum waatata ha hunnduko maɓɓe ba "gas" sey ɓe danna. Sey ɓe yara bales lekki on ɗum nyawɗo on yarata, to o ɗo mari asma.
kayan-yaji ɓeɗo defira nyamdu be mai do velna nyamdu sosai. Ɓeɗo wata ha ndar gortugal ko kusel, ɓeɗo wada yaaji be majun, ɓeɗo wata ha ndar tea, ɓeɗo wada jus be majun, ɓeɗo wata ɗum ha ndar soɓo.
Nda leshin ɓe ɗo ɓorna  leshin ni ha ɓangal, ha inde, ha ko nandi be mai. Ɓeɗo fauna yaha ofis fuu be mai nda leshin mai ko vooɗa.
Ɓingel gorko ɗo wati riga balejum be gajeren wondo ɓe  paɗe boɗejum, oɗo fiya bol tebul tenis, nda tebulwa mai fijirde je jungo.
Mangoro ɗo feɗi ha leggal mum nde bendai nonde man bulu, ɓe ɗo naftira be mangoro ɓe yara, ɗo mari nafu masin ha ɓandu ngam ɗo fadda nyawuji fere fere ha ɓandu.
Kompiwtaaji on haa nder booro ɓaleeji, gootel maajum ɗo maɓɓiti, himɓe ɗo naftira ɗum haa oofis, be haa saare, ngam vinndugo, be nanta janngugo, feere ɗo laarira fiim be maajum.
Himɓe siyaasa, mootaaji himɓe siyaasa on ɓe ɗo jeeri, ɗon polisji o ɗo jogi binndigaaru, o ɗo dogga,  tokka mootaaji maajum. Goɗɗo feere boo haa sera maajum o ɗo ɓamti junngo maako.
Guduma, ɓe ɗo naftira be guduma ,haa hippuki saare, tappugo koromje, leese. Guduma ɗo mari amfani soosay, kafinta'en ɗo naftira be may, makaniki'en ɗo naftira be may.

Olji daande rowɓe, andiraa ɗum sarqa, bee oldi noppi andiraa ɗum yeri, rowɓe ni ɗo waata oldi daande, bee noppi on, gam faunuki, yaha lamar koo jooɗugo saare, gam fauna vooɗa, ɓe ɗo ɓorni ha ɓanndu gunkiwa danewa.

Draya, draya ɓe ɗo naftira on ngam ɓe yorna hore je ɓe loti so fin ga, sai ɓe ɗisa ɗum ha hitte sai ɓe yorna horre goɗɗo atake yora ɓe wuja na ɗum nyebbam voɗa, ɓe ɗo naftira ɗum ha sare, ko ha Salon.
